title: Bookmark Folder Structure
description: Decide where a new bookmark belongs: the shared class folder, a student's personal folder, or neither.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Network, Peripherals, and the Device Lifecycle

educational.audience: Mentors and students using club laptops

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a new bookmark a student wants to save, the learner classifies whether it belongs in the shared class folder, a personal student folder, or the browser's general bookmark bar.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin tree with two branches and their example leaves
pedagogical.assessment: Give a link and ask which folder it belongs in and what breaks if it goes in the other one.
